source_note: 对含参数方程根的估计
english_source_note: Estimates for Roots of Parameterized Equations
callout_id: 对含参数方程根的估计#8
statement_en:
Let \(F(s,x):\\mathbb{R}^2\	o\\mathbb{R}\) satisfy
\\[
F\\in C^p(U\	o\\mathbb{R}),\\quad F(s^{*},x_k(0))=0,\\quad F_x(s^{*},x_k(0))\
eq 0
\\]
in some neighborhood \(U\) of \((s^{*},x_k(0))\). Then there exist a unique neighborhood \(V\) of \(s^{*}\) and a neighborhood \(W\) of \(x_k(0)\) such that
\\[
F(s,x(s))=0\\quad \\forall s\\in V,\\qquad x(s)\\in C^p(V\	o W),
\\]
and \(x(s)\) has the asymptotic expansion
\\[
x(s)=x(s^{*})+\\sum_{i=1}^p \\frac{x^{(i)}(s^{*})}{i!}(s-s^{*})^i+o(|s-s^{*}|^p).
\\]
callout_body: 设$F(s,x):\mathbb{R}^2\to \mathbb{R}$在$(s^{*},x_k(0))$的某个邻域$U$内满足$$F\in C^p(U\to \mathbb{R}),F(s^{*},x_k(0))=0,F_x(s^{*},x_k(0))\neq 0$$那么存在且唯一一个$s^{*}$的邻域$V$以及$x_k(0)$的邻域$W$使得$$F(s,x(s))=0\forall s\in V,x(s)\in C^p(V\to W)$$并且有渐近展开$$x(s)=x(s^{*})+\sum_{i=1}^p \frac{x^{(p)}(s)}{i!}(s-s^{*})^i+o(|s-s^{*}|^p)$$
